leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open and none should be opened. The balance is positive, the live offer is capped at available cash rather than at spending power, and if it wins the balance stays positive with room to spare. This matters more than usual because a negative balance at the start of a matchday scores nothing for the entire matchday. The temptation to bid on both candidates at once must be resisted on arithmetic, not taste: buying both would need far more than cash, and the only sales available afterwards without dropping under the legal squad minimum are the two lowest-value bodies, which together do not come close to covering the shortfall. That would leave an unwindable negative position running into the lock. The sequential fallback exists precisely so that the second attempt costs nothing in exposure. The lock is nearly a week away, so there is no deadline pressure of any kind and no reason to manufacture urgency out of a quiet board.

binding_gap: The binding constraint is squad size, not money. At the minimum legal size only one formation can be filled and the weakest possible body is forced into the eleven, so the gap that matters is the third attacker who legalises a better shape and pushes him out. That is exactly what the live offer addresses, and it is why a cheaper or higher-scoring player at a position already covered would be worth less. Nothing should be sold until that gap is closed, because selling first would drop the squad under the legal minimum and cost more than any purchase could return.

verdict.headline: No action needed tonight.
verdict.detail: No action needed tonight. The raised offer on Bambase Conte is live at the full cash ceiling exactly as the last run recommended, it is the largest single points gain available anywhere on the board, and it cannot be improved without opening a leveraged position that buys no additional win probability against the measured clearing distribution. Everything else on the market this run is either unaffordable while that offer is committed, or worse per point than what Georg already fields. The one genuinely new thing is a clean sequential fallback: if Conte loses, the Rohr listing resolves about half a day later, which frees the same cash to make a second attempt with no overlap and no leverage. Hold, let Conte resolve, and act on the fallback only if it is needed.

sell.reason: No sale is recommended and none should be made. At the current squad size any sale at all drops the eleven below the legal minimum and triggers the under-eleven penalty, which dwarfs every value consideration on the table. That applies to the bench-warming midfielder in particular: he has been designated a funding sale in older ledger entries and that designation is now actively dangerous, because it was written when the squad was one player larger. He is the injury cover and the eleventh body, and he stays. The same logic protects the low-scoring midfielder whose points-per-euro is the worst in the squad; he is a sale candidate on quality alone, but only once a replacement has actually landed, never before.

buy.reason: Conte remains the buy and the offer is already placed correctly, so there is nothing to do but let it resolve. He is the best efficiency on the board, he is a confirmed starter on a source published today, and the gain comes from the formation he unlocks rather than just the points he brings. Do not raise him further; the extra money would have to be leveraged, and there is no measured clearing between the current bid and the no-points-lost leveraged ceiling, so it would buy insurance against nothing. The Elversberg defender Rohr is the fallback and only the fallback. His listing resolves roughly half a day after Conte's, so the outcome will be known and the cash either spent or free before a decision is needed. Bid him only if Conte loses, and if so, bid the cash ceiling rather than the asking price, because an early absence of rival offers is a snapshot and not a forecast, and this ledger has already lost one player by trusting it. His match is played before his listing expires, so check his return first. Everything else was rejected: the Frankfurt full-back on a manager ask is a confirmed starter but costs several times more per marginal point than either candidate and would have to displace the Conte offer to be funded; the floor-priced Elversberg goalkeeper looks like the classic mispricing and is not one; and the expensive big names on the board remain worse per point than almost everyone Georg already owns.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: CONDITIONAL FALLBACK - BID ONLY IF THE CONTE OFFER LOSES. DO NOT BID WHILE THE CONTE OFFER IS LIVE. THE TIMING IS THE WHOLE POINT AND IT IS CLEAN: Conte (3204) resolves ~2026-09-05T12:51Z (exs 50780 read at 22:45Z); Rohr resolves ~2026-09-06T00:57Z (exs 94352). That is a TWELVE-HOUR GAP in which the outcome of the Conte bid is known and the cash is either spent or free. So this needs NO leverage, NO sale and NO overlap risk - it is a strictly sequential second attempt at the same money, and it is the answer to the Makengo problem (H5om1wi), where losing the only pre-lock resolver left Georg with cash and nothing to spend it on. THE POINTS CASE: Kickbase listing, prc exactly mv 9.726.134, ofc 0, st 0, stl [], DEF tid 77 = Elversberg (tn first-party). ap 87 off 5039 sec (84 min) in the 3:2 MD1 win over Leverkusen, one yellow, cv 8.900.000 and mv RISING (mvt 1, tfhmvt +74.619). Buying him takes the squad to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT, best legal shape 5-3-2, and he enters the eleven: 129 + (Matsima 138, ter Horst 143, Minjae 110, ROHR 87, Widmer 29 = 507) + (Nusa 226, Onyeka 139, Lokonga 44 = 409) + (Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 375) = 1420 against 1333 doing nothing = +87. Efficiency 9.726.134 / 87 = 111,8k per point, mid-pack in the squad - better than Minjae 110,2k is not true, but better than Nusa 118,4k, Baumann 133,8k, Guirassy 169,7k and Lokonga 221,2k, and far better than every big-name listing on the board (Koch 184k, Kimmich 198k, Kosugi 351k marginal). FITNESS VERIFIED THIS RUN ON A DATED SOURCE: bundesliga.com voraussichtliche Aufstellungen Spieltag 2, published 04.09.2026, starts him at Gladbach 05.09 13:30Z - "Kristof - Gyamerah, Pinckert, ROHR, Guenther..." - and Elversberg's absentees on that sheet are only Seifert (Syndesmosebandriss) and Zimmerschied (Rueckenprobleme). Absent from ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte. WHAT TO BID, AND WHY NOT MERELY mv: per H5om1wi, ofc 0 is a SNAPSHOT AND NOT A FORECAST - Makengo was ofc 1 with Georg alone at 08:45Z and was contested to +60,76% by 16:32Z, eight hours later. Rohr resolves ~26h out, which is more than enough time for a late rival, and a Kickbase listing is HIGHEST-BID-WINS, so raising genuinely buys win probability here (unlike a manager ask). Bid the full cash ceiling 11.343.624 = +16,63% over mv. That is inside the measured contested band and costs at most 1.617.490 over mv if nobody comes - the same insurance trade that B5fsu5e took on Conte, on the same idle cash, for a +87 instead of a +106. ABORT CONDITIONS, ANY ONE OF WHICH KILLS IT: (1) the Conte offer WINS at ~12:51Z - then cash is gone, the squad is 12 with 4-3-3 at 1439, and buying Rohr on top would need ~9,7M of leverage against a realisable unwind of only Amoako 1.569.143 + Widmer 1.852.587 = 3.421.730, leaving an unwindable negative balance that scores ZERO for all of MD3; (2) a source dated 05.09.2026 or later drops him from the Elversberg eleven; (3) his MD2 at Gladbach ends in an injury or a red card - note he kicks off 05.09 13:30Z and the listing resolves ~00:57Z on 06.09, so unlike Conte his match IS visible before the bid must land. Use that: check his MD2 return before bidding.

standing.name: Bambase Conte
standing.why: RAISE the live offer from 10.400.000 to 11.343.624 = the FULL CASH ceiling, +22,08% over mv 9.292.405. Replaces closed Bduul6s (price revision only; its points case and fitness case both stand). THE POINTS CASE, UNCHANGED AND RE-VERIFIED: squad is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, only 4-4-2 is legal, so Amoako ap 0 is compulsory in the XI. Conte makes it 12 = 1/4/4/3, legalises 4-3-3, and Amoako drops out: 1333 -> 1439 = +106, the largest single action available. He is also the best efficiency on the board at 9.292.405/106 = 87,7k per point (Rohr 111,8k is the next real candidate). FITNESS RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN on a dated source: Sports Mole preview 04.09.2026 01:36Z starts him in the Hoffenheim XI (Baumann; Coufal, Hajdari, Kabak, Bernardo; Avdullahu, Burger; Wimmer, CONTE, Daghim; Lemperle), TSG absentees only Asllani (knee) and Prass (muscle); Ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte lists ZERO Hoffenheim players; Kickbase st 0, stl []. WHY RAISE, AND WHY EXACTLY TO CASH. Georg's +11,92% sits in the bimodal dead space - uncontested listings clear at ~0% (measured 8 for 8), contested ones at +9% to +61%, so it beats only 1 of the 9 measured contested clearings while overpaying 1,1M if nobody comes. At +22,08% it beats 6 of 9. THE DECISIVE ARITHMETIC AGAINST LEVERAGE: the no-points-lost leveraged ceiling (cash + Amoako 1.569.143 = 12.912.767 = +38,97%) beats the SAME 6 of 9, because the next measured clearing above +20,96% is +48,28%. Leverage therefore buys ZERO additional win probability against the measured distribution while opening a negative balance and forcing the Amoako sale that removes the squad's only injury cover. Take the cash ceiling: no sale, balance stays positive, squad ends at 12 with cover. HONEST COST: if the listing stays uncontested he pays 2.051.219 over mv rather than 1.107.595 - an extra 943.624 burned for insurance on the only +106 on the board, against idle cash with no better use before MD3. Even at the full bid he is 107,0k per point, still better than Minjae, Nusa, Baumann, Guirassy and Lokonga.

That is a REPRICE DOWNWARD from the 12.676.617 / +15,20% Hmkgi49 recorded, so the ask is moving our way - and he is still a no. The only manager ask on the board this run, so H8t606f(A) and Hlovt4t's seller's-choice mechanic both apply and neither rescues him. FITNESS AND SELECTION ARE FINE AND THAT IS NOT THE OBJECTION: bundesliga.com voraussichtliche Aufstellungen Spieltag 2, 04.09.2026, starts him for Frankfurt v Augsburg 06.09 15:30Z - "Atubolu - Baum, Koch, Brassier, KOSUGI - Amaimouni, Chaibi, Onyedika, Uzun - Ebnoutalib, Burkardt" - corroborated by a Yahoo Sports preview 04.09.2026 15:40Z whose Frankfurt injury list is only Doan, Knauff and Collins. st 0, mvt 2. He is a confirmed starting Bundesliga full-back. REJECTED ON MARGINAL POINTS PER EURO, WHICH IS THE ONLY NUMBER THAT MATTERS FOR A FIFTH DEFENDER. His ap is 64. Buying him takes the squad to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT whose best legal shape is 5-3-2, and he enters the eleven ahead of WIDMER 29 - so the real purchase is +35 FIELDED POINTS FOR 12.300.000 = 351k PER MARGINAL POINT. Set that against what is already on the table: Conte 3204 is +106 for 11.343.500 (107k per marginal point at the full bid) and Rohr 3284 is +87 for ~9.726.134 (112k). Kosugi is more than three times worse than both, on a mandate that optimises points. THE HEADLINE ap 64 IS NOT THE PURCHASE - the 35-point gap over the man he displaces is, and this is the same distinction that correctly killed Robin Koch (Aha9xcq, +103 for 24,2M) one run ago. HE IS ALSO NOT AFFORDABLE THIS RUN WITHOUT WRECKING THE PLAN: cash is 11.343.624 and 11.343.500 of it is already committed to the live Conte offer, so he needs the Conte bid pulled or a sale on top, and pulling a +106 to fund a +35 is self-evidently wrong. REVERSAL CONDITION: he becomes interesting only if (a) the ask falls under roughly 4M, i.e. near 110k per MARGINAL point over whoever he would actually displace, recomputed at that time rather than reused from here, AND (b) Georg has cash with no better claim on it, AND (c) he still projects as a Frankfurt starter on a source dated then. A further cut in PhiL95's ask is NOT by itself a reversal - the gap to close is roughly 8M, not 400k.

REVERSAL CONDITION: a dated source 31.08.2026 or later reporting that KRISTOF is injured, suspended or dropped AND a source naming Lehmann in the Elversberg starting eleven. movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. There are no manager asks priced below market value anywhere on the board, so the mechanism a flip depends on is simply absent, and the instant round-trips rival managers keep making have been measured repeatedly at margins under one percent, which is noise rather than an edge. There is however one real value signal worth recording rather than acting on. Matchday two has begun, and the Stuttgart defender on the board posted a very large score in the opening fixture, which finished after the daily market-value update had already run. His price therefore does not yet contain that performance and mvt still reads as falling. He is unaffordable and poor value on points regardless, so this is not a recommendation to buy him; it is a free and unusually clean measurement of how much a big matchday actually moves a market value, which underpins every sell-into-strength argument in the ledger and has never been measured here. The next run should record his value immediately after the next daily update.

fitness.sweep: A full squad-wide sweep came back clean. Every squad player carries a zero status flag with an empty status list first-party, and the league-wide injured and suspended table plus the matchday absentee lists name none of them. Both buy candidates were verified as starters on sources published today. The Augsburg striker false alarm from the previous run stays refuted and is now better supported: two independent current sources still start him, and the coach press conference the last run predicted would arrive too late has in fact taken place, though its content was not extractable as text. The Bayern centre-back question is selection rather than fitness and remains genuinely open, with the freshest matchday-two source preferring his rival; there is no injury, nothing notifiable, and no action available, but his club's lineup must be re-checked from scratch before the next matchday rather than carried forward. One measurement correction was logged this run that changes how the whole board must be read: the average-points field is a per-appearance mean and not a season total, and now that the opening fixture of the matchday has been played, some clubs carry two-match means while the rest still carry one-match means, so cross-player comparisons are no longer like for like.
